title: New supplier onboarding
description: When a new Supplier is created, email them our onboarding checklist and assign an onboarding check to the purchase team.

config.subject: Welcome aboard, {{ trigger.doc.supplier_name }}
config.message:
Dear {{ trigger.doc.supplier_name }},

Thank you for registering as a supplier. To complete onboarding, please reply to this email with:

  • GST registration certificate
  • PAN card
  • Cancelled cheque or bank letter
  • Contact person for purchase orders

Regards,
Purchase team

config.description: Check onboarding documents for supplier {{ trigger.doc.supplier_name }}{% if not nodes.welcome_email %} (no email address on file, contact them directly){% endif %}
